items.label: Ondine
items.note: The work, for nine musicians and live electronics, grew from a cello harmonic breaking into noise. Hannu Lintu conducts Avanti! in a programme that places this early electronic work beside the chamber version of Graal théâtre.

items.label: harmonia mundi
items.note: Amin Maalouf’s libretto sends the troubadour Jaufré Rudel across the sea to Clémence, countess of Tripoli. Kent Nagano, who conducted the première at Salzburg in 2000, conducts this studio recording, released in 2009, with a new cast: Daniel Belcher, Ekaterina Lekhina and Marie-Ange Todorovitch. All five acts are included, among them the long crossing before the lovers meet.
